title: Quick Caramelized Saudi Arabian Haddock Skillet
description: A flavorful and aromatic weeknight dish featuring haddock, inspired by Saudi Arabian cuisine, with a floral and slightly sweet caramelized crust, vegan-friendly by substituting fish with tofu or portobello mushrooms if needed.

ingredients.name: haddock fillets
ingredients.notes: or substitute with tofu or portobello mushrooms for vegan option

instructions: Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the onion and cook until it starts to caramelize, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic and cook for another minute, until fragrant.
Add the cardamom pods and cook for 1 minute, until aromatic.
Add the haddock fillets and cook for 3-4 minutes per side, until cooked through.
Remove the haddock from the skillet and set aside.
Add the rose water and lemon juice to the skillet and stir to combine.
Scrape up any browned bits from the bottom of the skillet.
Return the haddock to the skillet and spoon some of the caramelized sauce over the top.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
